comment: Files that must reach the deployed origin as static assets. Vite copies public/ into dist/, and the control-plane Worker serves dist/ through its ASSETS binding. This list is the contract: test/published-assets.test.ts checks the sources exist, and .github/workflows/release.yml checks them again before a tag deploys. Both sides read THIS file — never hand-edit one side. Add an entry when a page must survive a deploy; removing one is a deliberate un-publishing.
